note: Frontend releases ship as fe/patches.json: ordered exact string replacements applied to the repo's index.html at boot by server.js (v10+), gated by baseSha256 (sha256 of the repo index.html the patches expect) and expectedSha256 (sha256 of the patched result). Any failure serves the repo index.html unchanged. Live state: GET /api/fe-info. Consolidation: upload a fresh full index.html via GitHub web and reset patches.json to {"patches":[]} in the same release.
